scope.size_method: linear sweep with capstone from disk bytes, bounded by next function start

key_anchors.00419cc0: engine allocator singleton getter (Mit) - not STL

categories.name: STL (Dinkumware VC8) template instantiation
categories.method: Two mechanical signals (calls _invalid_parameter_noinfo @00bf6713; pushes one of six STL throw-message strings) flag 7231 functions. Precision of the SCL signal by size bin and the STL share outside the signals were measured by manually classifying 108 decompiled random samples (12 per stratum). Point = throw-site count + precision*SCL-callers + outside-rate*unflagged, per bin; low/high use the sample confidence bounds.

categories.name: Compiler-generated scalar deleting destructor (??_G)
categories.method: pattern: calls operator delete, contains 'test byte ptr [esp+4|8],1', ends 'ret 4' (any size). High bound allows variants with an inlined dtor body or another flag register.

categories.name: Compiler-generated vector deleting destructor / array-member ctor helpers
Static-object dtor stubs ($E) and atexit initializers
categories.method: 'mov ecx, imm32; jmp dtor' stubs plus functions calling _atexit/__onexit. Dynamic initializers that do not register atexit are not detected; high bound assumes one initializer per dtor stub.

categories.name: Tiny trivial functions (<=32 measured bytes, not STL/dtor/thunk)
categories.method: 4116 functions have measured body <=32 bytes and no STL signal; sampling shows about one third of the 17-32 byte ones are STL helpers (counted in the STL row), the rest are getters/setters/forwarders/small ctors-dtors. 579 match exact opcode patterns.

categories.name: In-house engine (Mit) template instantiations: refcounted-pointer release, dynamic array push/resize, engine string helpers
categories.method: sample-based only: 2-3 of 12 in the 17-48 byte strata and ~1 of 12 in larger strata show the same few shapes (InterlockedDecrement release, realloc+copy push_back, string resize via 0041dd40). Not std::, but each shape is one template to write once.

categories.name: Remaining hand-reconstruction candidates (game/engine logic)
categories.method: in-scope total minus the categories above (point uses point estimates; low/high use opposite bounds).

tagging_rules.rule: calls 00bf6713 AND 97 <= size <= 256 AND calls nothing outside {CRT helpers, other tagged STL}
body contains 'push imm32' with imm32 in the six STL throw-string addresses (68 e0 37 ce 00 etc.)
'if (n) if (0xffffffff/n < K) throw bad_alloc; operator new(n*K)' - calls 00bf6340 with bad_alloc vftable then 00bf681b
loop 'while (node->isnil_byte == 0) node = node->left|right' with isnil at node+0x15/0x19/0x1d/0x29/0x31/0x99; recursion+free variant = _Tree::_Erase; rotate variant = _Lrotate/_Rrotate
pointer-stride loop copying a value or range with no other calls (std::fill/_Fill_n/_Copy_opt/_Destroy_range)
calls operator delete, contains 'test byte ptr [esp+4|8],1', ends 'ret 4'
